ads_ratio.reason: Direct-listed foreign private issuer: one NYSE-traded ONON share is one Class A ordinary share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.
ads_ratio.source: On Holding AG Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed March 3, 2026): share capital note shows 306,847,124 Class A Ordinary Shares issued, of which 296,873,353 were outstanding at December 31, 2025 — exactly the engine's shares_diluted_latest (296,873,353); the NYSE-listed security (ONON) is the Class A ordinary share itself, listed directly, not an ADS

moat_against: No network effects and near-zero switching costs: runners switch shoe brands freely and brand heat is fashion-exposed
Incumbents fighting back: Nike regained running share in North America/Western Europe in FY2026, Hoka gains above $120 price points; both outspend On by multiples
Wholesale still 54.3% of sales and decelerated sharply in Q2 2026 as On cut shipments to protect full-price positioning — growth is partly channel-managed
Guided deceleration is real: FY2026 constant-currency growth trimmed to low-20s from at least 23%, vs +48.6% reported revenue growth in FY2025
Single-brand, footwear-concentrated model now spending into unproven categories (football/golf via expensive athlete signings); CHF reporting adds FX noise to USD results
moat_for: Premium brand with proven pricing power: Q2 2026 gross margin 65.4% and 2026 guidance raised to at least 65%, absorbed US tariffs at full price
Proprietary product technology: CloudTec cushioning, LightSpray and SURREAL foam franchises that competitors cannot copy directly
DTC channel compounding fastest (Q2 +26% reported, 45.7% of sales) at structurally higher margins, plus a growing owned-store network
Small share (~2-3% of global running) against a huge premium TAM, with APAC momentum (Q2 APAC-led growth, >20% of sales) and apparel scaling (+47.7% in Q2)
Affluent customer base that has held up better than mass-market consumers in a polarized economy
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat: a genuine premium brand with proprietary CloudTec/LightSpray innovation and proven pricing power (Q2 2026 gross margin 65.4%, guidance raised to at least 65% for 2026) and a fast-growing higher-margin DTC channel (45.7% of Q2 sales), at only ~2-3% global running share so the runway is long — but footwear has no network effects or switching costs, brand heat must be re-earned each season, and Nike (regaining running share under a new CEO), Adidas and Hoka are larger, better-funded and now competing directly in On's premium lane, as the promotional Americas wholesale market in 2026 showed.
name: On Holding AG
one_liner: Premium sportswear brand, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% on filing-based numbers: weighted IRR 9.67%, weighted IV@15 $18.30 vs $35.13 price; clears 15% only below ~$18.30, and even the super-bull case (17.07% IRR) barely clears it.
sector: Consumer Discretionary / Premium performance sportswear (footwear & apparel)
